name: San Francisco SPCA - Spay/Neuter
description: Affordable spay/neuter surgery for cats and dogs, with financial assistance available
fullDescription: The SF SPCA's Spay/Neuter Clinic at its Mission Campus offers affordable spay and neuter surgery for cats and dogs, with financial assistance available.
whatTheyOffer:
- Affordable spay and neuter surgery for dogs and cats
- Pain medication, recovery cone, and nail trim included
- Financial assistance available for spay/neuter surgeries
- Add-on services: microchipping, vaccines, parasite treatment, heartworm and FIV/FeLV testing
howToGetIt:
1. Book online or text 415-554-3084 (Tuesday-Saturday, 8 am-6 pm)
2. Ask about cost and financial assistance when scheduling
3. On surgery day, cats check in 7:30-8 am and dogs 8-8:30 am; pickup is at 4:30 pm
4. Pay fees at or before check-in
keywords: SF SPCA, San Francisco SPCA, spay, neuter, financial assistance, dog, cat, sterilization, fix pet, affordable surgery
